# netactuate_current_server (Data Source)

Reads metadata for the server associated with the current execution environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_current_server" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud_pool_id` (Number) Cloud pool ID, or zero when the API returns null.
- `hostname` (String) Server hostname.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed` (Number) Installed flag as returned by the API.
- `location` (String) Server location name.
- `location_id` (Number) Server location ID.
- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID.
- `os` (String) Server operating system name.
- `os_id` (Number) Server operating system ID.
- `package` (String) Server package name.
- `package_billing_contract_id` (Number) Server contract ID, from the API field named contract_id.
- `plan_id` (Number) Server plan ID.
- `primary_ipv4` (String) Server primary IPv4 address.
- `primary_ipv6` (String) Server primary IPv6 address.
- `state` (String) Server power state.
- `status` (String) Server status.
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID, or zero when the API returns null.
- `vpc_reserved_network` (String) Reserved VPC network address.
